Aims of the course:
The aim of the course is to introduce students to the impact of technology on business management, the principles and problems of IT management and the business transformation enabled by technology.
 
Learning outcomes and competences:
Upon completion of the course, the student will be able to:
• Apply the procedures of process management
• Identify business innovation potentials based on current technologies
• Analyze and design a basic global business model
• Understand the relationship between technology and business
• perceive and solve problems that arise in managing technology in business
• understand the different principles and models of technology management in business (IT process management, IT service management, agile approaches, etc.)
• identify current changes in the industry, identify best practices and discuss them.
 
Course contents:
The course consists of two interconnected parts. The first part introduces students to the business transformation enabled by technology and how process management is related to it all. The second part will then continue and focus on a specific area of the impact of technology on business management, namely the management of business informatics. It will introduce students to the principles and issues of IT management and how technology influences this. Each part involves three four-hour blocks of exercises with adequate time for individual and team work by students.
Business processes and process management of organizations (history, principles, distortions):
• Process management and the purpose of business process modeling
• business engineering based on current technologies
• service-oriented management
• other contexts: development of information systems, knowledge management, organisation development
Management of business informatics, problems and principles:
• IT strategic management in relation to business, IT governance
• IT process management and IT service management
• agile approaches to IT and business management
• Technology-dependent business continuity management
